faqs.question: Do I need prior startup or business experience?
faqs.answer: Not at all. Sprint is designed for complete beginners. We'll teach you everything you need to go from zero to pitch-ready in 48 hours.

faqs.question: Can I participate if I don't have a team yet?
faqs.answer: Yes! You can participate solo or form teams of up to 4 people. We'll facilitate team formation during the opening session if you want to collaborate.

faqs.question: What should I bring to the event?
faqs.answer: Bring your laptop, charger, notebook, and an open mind. We'll provide the structure, mentorship, and guidance—you bring the ambition.

faqs.question: Will food/meals be provided?
faqs.answer: Specific meal arrangements vary by city. Details will be shared with registered participants closer to the event date.

faqs.question: What happens after Sprint ends? Can I continue working on my idea?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. All participants gain access to the MLV community for continued mentorship, resources, and networking. Top teams may also receive discounts to our summer programs.

faqs.question: Is this online or in-person?
faqs.answer: Hybrid. Speaker sessions and workshops are virtual (shared across all three cities), while Friday kickoff and Sunday Demo Day are in-person at your local venue.

faqs.question: What are the prizes?
faqs.answer: We're finalizing our prize pool now, but all participants will receive certificates, and top teams will win exclusive merchandise and discounts to MLV's product ecosystem. Details coming soon.

faqs.question: Can parents attend or observe?
faqs.answer: Parents are welcome to attend the closing ceremony and Demo Day on Sunday to watch pitches and celebrate their students' achievements.
